get.description: Search for entities by matching type (people, community, event, post, places). Includes filters for age range, max distance, verified profiles, what they're looking for, sexual orientation, relationship status, and interests.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search keyword to match against entities (e.g. name/username/profile display name for people, name/description/tags for communities, title/description/location/host_name for events, title/description for posts)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specific type of content to search. Allowed values: people, community, event, post, places. If null, returns all matching types.

parameters.name: max_distance
parameters.description: Maximum distance filter in kilometers for location/people (e.g. 50)

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of current user location for distance calculation (e.g. 37.7749)

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of current user location for distance calculation (e.g. -122.4194)

parameters.name: verified_only
parameters.description: Filter only verified profiles (1 or true for verified profiles only, 0 or false for all)

parameters.name: looking_for
parameters.description: Filter by what they are looking for. Accepts ID(s), name(s), array, or comma-separated string (e.g. 1, 2, 'Friends', 'Dating', 'Long-term relationship', 'Casual / nothing serious', 'Community / meetups')

parameters.name: sexual_orientation
parameters.description: Filter by sexual orientation. Accepts ID(s), name(s), array, or comma-separated string (e.g. 1, 2, 'Gay', 'Lesbian', 'Bisexual', 'Pansexual', 'Straight', 'Queer')

parameters.name: relationship_status
parameters.description: Filter by relationship status. Accepts ID(s), name(s), array, or comma-separated string (e.g. 1, 2, 'Single', 'Dating / seeing someone', 'In a relationship', 'Engaged', 'Married', 'Open relationship')

parameters.name: interests
parameters.description: Filter by interests/hobbies. Accepts ID(s), title(s), array, or comma-separated string (e.g. 1,2 or 'Music,Sports')
